text:
noah: Quick heads-up — planning X + LinkedIn cadence for the GovTech webinar next Wed. Need copy variants, 3 visual assets, and inbound lead routing. Can people call Dibs?

marta: Dibs on copy. I'll draft two angles: (A) benchmark narrative (latency/cost wins) and (B) customer story highlight. Want punchy 1-liners + 2 tweet thread followups.

cj: For benchmarks let's show: median latency, tokens/s saved, and demo signup lift. KPI to watch: CTR -> demo form conversion. Also propose A/B test for CTA wording.

sam: Assets: hero card (1200x628), carousel frames (1080x1080), and a short 20s clip for LinkedIn. Who has brand-approved screenshots? Need raw screens by EOD Fri.

olivia: I can own inbound routing. Plan: UTM params -> HubSpot list -> SDR queue "webinar-govtech". Example UTM: ?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=govtech_launch&utm_content=benchA

harry: Scheduling recs: X at 8:30am PT (thread opener), follow-up thread at 12:30pm PT, LinkedIn post at 10am PT. Stagger copies to avoid overlap across timezones. Also tagging speakers in first post.

marta: Copy snippet A (benchmark): "We cut inference latency by 3x, saving teams 65% per-token cost — here's how we did it. RSVP: [link]". Copy B (customer): "How Acme reduced latency and shipped a new feature. Join our webinar Wed. [link]"

noah: Love those. Quick ask — include variant with 'live demo' vs 'best practices' CTAs for A/B.

sam: I'll mock the hero and a gif from the demo clip. Uploading to the assets folder in Drive: /Marketing/GovTech/Webinar/ by Tue.

olivia: Final routing checklist: (1) Confirm HubSpot form field mapping, (2) Add tag + lead score rule for 'attended', (3) Hook for auto-follow: 'thanks' email with recording. Will need the landing page field names.

cj: Bench narrative idea: publish a short thread with 3 tweets: 1) stat + hook, 2) quick technical bit (3 bullet points), 3) CTA + signup. We'll use #LLOps #Inference and tag speakers.

harry: Post-launch engagement: If a post gets >200 replies in first hour, we trigger a reply thread with more technical depth. Also route high intent leads to AE queue via Slack alert.

marta: Deadlines: copy variants Tue EOD, design assets Wed EOD, final schedule Thu morning. Who can QA the landing page?

anne: I can QA landing page and confirm form fields. Also will run a quick link-check and smoke test of UTMs before go-live.

noah: Thanks team — assigning tasks in the project board. Next sync Friday 11am PT. :thumbsup:
